newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila overnight money steady in liquid market.
newsitem.headline: Manila overnight money steady in liquid market.

text.p: * Market volume fell to 12.053 bln from 14.618 bln pesos
Manila overnight money stood unchanged at an average of 9.9375 percent on Wednesday on the lack of factors to affect it, traders said.
The Central Bank continued to maintain its overnight borrowing rate at 9.9 percent, which placed a floor on rates in a liquid market, they said.
Done rates were from 10.28125 to 9.9375 percent, with 26 lenders and 16 borrowers.
The secondary market experienced more active trading with banks buying up bills.
"Banks are taking positions thinking rates will still go down," a big bank dealer said.
A Reuters poll of seven financial institutions showed bid rates of 9.46 to 9.55 percent for the three-month bills; 9.80 to 10.00 for the six months; and 10.35 to 10.40 percent for the one-year bills.
